transactions.property_name: CapitaSpring - Commercial Component (remaining 55% interest via Glory Office Trust)
transactions.counterparty: Glory Office Pte. Ltd. (45%, related party) and MEA Commercial Holdings Pte. Ltd. (10%, third party)
transactions.citation: p696/928-929: 'Completed the acquisition of the remaining 55% interest in CapitaSpring's Commercial Component on 26 August 2025'; 'Acquired 55% interest in the Commercial Component of CapitaSpring from Glory Office Pte. Ltd. and MEA Commercial Holdings Pte. Ltd. at an entry yield of low 4%'; 'Agreed property value: S$1,900.0 million on a 100% basis'; footnote 6 (p734): 'Based on 55% of the agreed property value of S$1.9 billion. Savills Valuation and Professional Services (S) Pte Ltd and Knight Frank Pte Ltd had respectively valued the Commercial Component at CapitaSpring at S$1,905.0 million and S$1,895.0 million as at 30 June 2025'.
transactions.notes: Acquisition of the remaining 55% interest in Glory Office Trust (which holds the Commercial Component of CapitaSpring), making it wholly owned. purchase_price S$478.7m is the total purchase consideration including acquisition costs for the 55% interest (per prior extraction's Note 32 citation, not independently re-quoted in this pass). No gain/loss concept applies to an acquisition, so the five divestment fields are left null. Agreed property value on a 100% basis (S$1,900.0m) sits almost exactly between the two independent valuations (Savills S$1,905.0m, Knight Frank S$1,895.0m; average S$1,900.0m) as at 30 Jun 2025 -- i.e. essentially a 0% premium/discount to independent valuation, but this is not populated as gain_loss_pct since that field is reserved for divestments per SPEC.

transactions.property_name: CapitaSpring - Serviced Residence Component (45% interest via Glory SR Trust)
transactions.counterparty: RP Riverside II (B.V.I.) Limited and YTL Riverside Pte. Ltd.
transactions.citation: p892-894: 'Divested 45% interest in the SR Component of CapitaSpring to RP Riverside II (B.V.I.) Limited and YTL Riverside Pte. Ltd. at an estimated exit yield of 3.6%'; 'Agreed property value: S$280.0 million on a 100% basis'; footnote 2 (p902): 'Cushman & Wakefield VHS Pte. Ltd. had valued the SR Component of CapitaSpring at S$278.5 million as at 31 December 2024 using the income capitalisation and discounted cashflow methods.'
transactions.notes: 45% JV interest sale -- interest_pct recorded as 0.45. The AR discloses the gross consideration for the 45% interest as S$126.0m (per prior extraction, Note 32/34 citation, p189 source_page) but does NOT disclose a per-transaction premium/discount percentage, so gain_loss_pct is DERIVED, and CRITICALLY on a same-basis 45% share of the independent valuation, not the whole-property valuation: 45% x S$278,500,000 (Cushman & Wakefield, as at 31 Dec 2024) = S$125,325,000; (126,000,000-125,325,000)/125,325,000*100 = +0.54%. This is deliberately NOT computed against the full 100%-basis valuation (S$278.5m or the agreed S$280.0m), which would understate the true premium by mixing a 45%-share price against a 100%-share reference. Separately disclosed and NOT conflated with gain_loss_pct: net cash inflow on divestment of the JV was S$14.211m (Statement of Cash Flows/Note 34, per prior extraction -- a net-of-completion-mechanics cash-flow figure, not comparable to the gross S$126.0m consideration), and the audited accounting net gain on divestment recognised was only S$26,000 (Note 34), i.e. essentially at carrying value -- this reflects the JV's book carrying value rather than the independent property valuation and is a much smaller figure than the S$126.0m-vs-S$125.325m valuation-basis premium computed above.

transactions.property_name: Bukit Panjang Plaza (90 of 91 strata lots)
transactions.counterparty: SG Bravo Retail Property Pte. Ltd.
transactions.citation: p658 (fn2): 'Sale of 90 out of 91 strata lots in Bukit Panjang Plaza was announced on 14 January 2026 at S$428.0 million and was completed on 27 February 2026.'; p748: 'Also in January 2026, CICT announced the divestment of Bukit Panjang Plaza for S$428.0 million at an exit yield of around the mid-4% level.'; p904-908: 'Agreed property value: S$428.0 million'; 'Completion: 27 February 2026'.
transactions.notes: Subsequent-event divestment: sale announced 14 Jan 2026, completed 27 Feb 2026, both AFTER FYE 31 Dec 2025, but disclosed as completed by the time the FY2025 AR was issued -- status recorded 'completed', deal_id year uses 2026 (the year the deal actually completed) per SPEC's cross-year convention. No accounting gain was recognised in FY2025 (the property was reclassified to asset held for sale and measured at fair value as at 31 Dec 2025). gain_loss_pct DERIVED against the 31 Dec 2025 held-for-sale carrying value of S$390,885,000 (Portfolio Statement, per prior extraction citation, p109/p190): (428,000,000-390,885,000)/390,885,000*100 = +9.49%. An alternative reference exists -- Cushman & Wakefield's independent valuation of S$389.0m as at 31 Dec 2025 (per prior extraction citation) -- which would give a slightly different +10.03% vs_valuation figure; book_value (the held-for-sale carrying amount) was chosen here as the primary reference since it is the more precisely disclosed and audited figure, but the valuation-basis alternative is noted for completeness. No AR-disclosed net-of-cost proceeds figure was found; sale price used is the gross S$428.0m agreed property value.
